# ClawFetch MCP Server
> MCP server for AI agents to access web intelligence via ClawFetch API with x402 micropayments (USDC on Base).
> Install: npm install -g @clawfetch/mcp
> Website: https://clawfetch.ai
> Transport: stdio (default) | Streamable HTTP (for remote/multi-session)

## Tools (9 total)

### Web Fetching
- fetch_url: Fetch any URL as clean markdown. Cost: $0.001
- render_page: Render JS-heavy pages (SPAs, React, dynamic content) via headless browser. Cost: $0.002

### Structured Data Extraction
- extract_data: Extract typed data from 17+ site types (GitHub repos/profiles, npm/PyPI packages, X/Twitter profiles, LinkedIn, YouTube, Product Hunt, Hacker News, Reddit, Crunchbase, Wikipedia). Cost: $0.003
- list_extractors: List all supported extractor types and their output schemas. Cost: $0.001

### Research
- research_topic: Multi-source research with citations — synthesizes information from multiple web sources. Cost: $0.01

### Domain Intelligence
- check_domains: Check availability of specific domain names (up to 10 at once). Cost: $0.002
- suggest_domains: Generate available domain name suggestions for a concept/keyword. Cost: $0.002

### Utility
- health_check: Check ClawFetch API health status. Free.
- wallet_info: Show the payment wallet address and balance info. Free.

## Setup
Requires CLAWFETCH_PRIVATE_KEY env var — an Ethereum private key (0x-prefixed) for x402 micropayments.
Fund the corresponding address with USDC on Base mainnet.
No API keys. No billing dashboards. Pay-per-use via x402 protocol.

## Configuration
| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| CLAWFETCH_PRIVATE_KEY | (required) | Ethereum private key for x402 payments |
| CLAWFETCH_BASE_URL | https://api.clawfetch.ai | API endpoint |
| CLAWFETCH_TRANSPORT | stdio | Transport: stdio or http |
| CLAWFETCH_PORT | 3001 | HTTP server port |
| CLAWFETCH_TIMEOUT_MS | 60000 | Request timeout |

## Pricing
$1 USDC gets you: 1,000 page fetches, 500 JS renders, 333 data extractions, or 100 research queries.
